description: A script for generating interface properties on global objects, primarily used in web IDL build processes within Chromium/Blink projects. It processes IDL files, extracts attributes, and generates partial interface definitions with constructor attributes.

methods.name: parse_options
methods.description: Parses command-line options for IDL files list and global objects file.

methods.name: flatten_list
methods.description: Flattens an iterable of iterables into a single list.

methods.name: interface_name_to_constructors
methods.description: Returns constructors for a given interface name.

methods.name: record_global_constructors
methods.description: Processes an IDL file to record global constructors based on its attributes.

methods.name: generate_global_constructors_list
methods.description: Generates a list of constructor attribute strings based on extended attributes.

methods.name: write_global_constructors_partial_interface
methods.description: Writes a partial interface definition with constructor attributes to a file.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates reading IDL files, processing them, and generating partial interface files.
